mapper.insert: INSERT INTO comment(video_id, user_id, content, parent_id, like_count, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{videoId}, #{userId}, #{content}, #{parentId}, #{likeCount}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.video_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.parent_id, c.like_count, c.status, c.create_time, c.update_time, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM comment c LEFT JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id WHERE c.video_id = #{videoId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.create_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE comment SET status = 0, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
